FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

# Avoid interruptive messages from tzdata
ENV TZ=Europe/Berlin
RUN ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone

# Install git first, separately from other packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other relevant packages and build tools
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y curl tini libcap2-bin libglib2.0-0 libx11-6 libnss3 fontconfig gcc bash && \
    apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* || exit 0

WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/Graylog2/graylog2-server.git || exit 0

WORKDIR /app/graylog2-server

# Any additional setup commands can be added here
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:

          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}

        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

on:

  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status

        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \

  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \

    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

  cancel-in-progress: true

            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \

  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \

    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \

    --directory \

    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \

    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \

COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

        id: pr-string-changed

        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then

  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

        id: pr-string-changed

        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre-jammy

ARG GRAYLOG_VERSION
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG GRAYLOG_HOME=/usr/share/graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_USER=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_UID=1100
ARG GRAYLOG_GROUP=graylog
ARG GRAYLOG_GID=1100
ARG DEBUG_OPTS=''

WORKDIR ${GRAYLOG_HOME}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \

    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \

  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

on:

        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:

          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}

# hadolint ignore=DL3027,DL3008
RUN \
  echo "export BUILD_DATE=${BUILD_DATE}"           >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_VERSION=${GRAYLOG_VERSION}" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_SERVER_JAVA_OPTS='-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true -Djdk.tls.acknowledgeCloseNotify=true -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -server -XX:-OmitStackTraceInFastThrow " ${DEBUG_OPTS} "'" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_HOME=${GRAYLOG_HOME}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_BIN_DIR=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_USER=${GRAYLOG_USER}"       >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GROUP=${GRAYLOG_GROUP}"     >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_UID=${GRAYLOG_UID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_GID=${GRAYLOG_GID}"         >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_DISABLE_SANDBOX=true" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export GRAYLOG_REPORT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600" >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  echo "export PATH=${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"   >> /etc/profile.d/graylog.sh && \
  apt-get update  > /dev/null && \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends --assume-yes \
    curl \
    tini \
    libcap2-bin \
    libglib2.0-0 \
    libx11-6 \
    libnss3 \
    fontconfig > /dev/null && \
  addgroup \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" && \
  adduser \
    --disabled-password \
    --disabled-login \
    --gecos '' \
    --home ${GRAYLOG_HOME} \
    --uid "${GRAYLOG_UID}" \
    --gid "${GRAYLOG_GID}" \
    --quiet \
    "${GRAYLOG_USER}" && \
  chown --recursive "${GRAYLOG_USER}":"${GRAYLOG_GROUP}" ${GRAYLOG_HOME} && \
  setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' "${JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" && \
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/blob/da594d91b0364d5f1a32e0ce6b4d3fd8a9116844/8/jdk/slim-bullseye/Dockerfile#L105
  # https://github.com/docker-library/openjdk/issues/331#issuecomment-498834472
  find "$JAVA_HOME/lib" -name '*.so' -exec dirname '{}' ';' | sort -u > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/docker-openjdk.conf && \
  ldconfig && \
  apt-get remove --assume-yes --purge \
    apt-utils > /dev/null && \
  rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* && \
  apt-get clean > /dev/null && \
  apt autoremove --assume-yes > /dev/null && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/cache/debconf/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/log/* \
    /usr/share/X11 \
    /usr/share/doc/* 2> /dev/null

EXPOSE 9000
USER ${GRAYLOG_USER}

RUN \
  install \
    --directory \
    --mode=0750 \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/journal \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/data \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/contentpacks \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/lib \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/log \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/plugin \
    ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/bin

COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /
COPY graylog.conf ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config
COPY log4j2.xml ${GRAYLOG_HOME}/data/config

ENTRYPOINT ["tini", "--", "/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["graylog"]

        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status

        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  dispatchedPR:
    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

on:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

      - name: Dispatch job to graylog-project-internal
        if: ${{ github.event.action != 'edited' || steps.pr-string-changed.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: >
          gh workflow run -R Graylog2/graylog-project-internal pr-build.yml --ref master
          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
          -f head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          -f initial_actor="${{ github.actor }}/${{ github.triggering_actor }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_GRAYLOG_PROJECT_INTERNAL_WORKFLOW_RW }}

      - name: Give dispatched build time to add its status
        run: sleep 20
        # This is mostly cosmetic. If this workflow finishes before the dispatched
        # build creates the status on the PR, the build will show up green for a while.

        id: pr-string-changed

        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}

    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:

          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}

          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}

name: Request dispatched PR Build

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [ opened, reopened, synchronize, edited ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

    name: Dispatch wait and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: Check if PR edit changed deps string
        if: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' }}
        id: pr-string-changed
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          old_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$OLD_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          new_pr_string=$(grep -P '^/(jenkins-pr-deps|jpd|prd)' <<< "$NEW_PR_BODY" | \
            grep -ioP '(Graylog2/\S+?#|https?://github.com/Graylog2/\S+?/pull/)[0-9]+' || true)
          if [ "$old_pr_string" != "$new_pr_string" ]; then
            echo "PR deps string change detected: \"$old_pr_string\" -> \"$new_pr_string\""
            echo "Re-triggering PR build..."
            exit 0
          fi
          exit 1
        env:
          OLD_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.changes.body.from }}"
          NEW_PR_BODY: "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"

          -f caller_repo=${{ github.repository }}
          -f caller_pr_nr=${{ github.event.number }}
          -f caller_base_branch=${{ github.base_ref || github.ref_name }}
          -f caller_head_branch=${{ github.head_ref }}
